A bowl is underneath; the bed has been moved. Bevin said the wall switch is off but does not know whether the circuit is isolated. ## 2025-06-18 08:27:00 UTC — event 003 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) Arlen told Bevin not to touch the wet fitting, nearby switches, or the ceiling, and to keep people out of the affected bedroom. Bevin was asked not to try an unfamiliar consumer-unit breaker and to call emergency services if there were sparks, smoke, falling material, or an immediate danger. ## 2025-06-18 08:34:00 UTC — event 004 - **Channel:** SMS - **From:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) I have left the bedroom and am keeping the door closed. The dripping continues. No sparks or smoke that I can see. ## 2025-06-18 08:43:00 UTC — event 005 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Selka Venn (Building Manager, Tallowmere Row) Arlen asked whether Selka could identify a water isolation point or a building emergency-access procedure. Niko said he was away, had no key, and had not given standing permission for entry in his absence. He asked to be updated before any non-routine access. ## 2025-06-18 09:03:00 UTC — event 007 - **Channel:** Portal - **From:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Bevin reported water at the ceiling light and a damp patch extending toward the bedroom wall. Bevin could not identify the source or confirm conditions in the space above the ceiling and asked that the details be kept within the maintenance team. ## 2025-06-18 09:15:00 UTC — event 008 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Daro Fen (Contractor, Brindle Flow Plumbing) Arlen described the active leak and suspected Flat 3 as a possible source, not a confirmed one. Daro could attend from 10:30 but said source tracing would require access to the source flat. He could not identify or isolate an unknown supply from Flat 2. ## 2025-06-18 09:24:00 UTC — event 009 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Yara Mallow (Tenant, Flat 3) Yara said she would not agree to entry while away and could not return before 17:30. She asked that no key be used. She could answer calls during a break around noon. ## 2025-06-18 09:37:00 UTC — event 010 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Selka Venn (Building Manager, Tallowmere Row) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Selka offered to meet Daro at 10:30 and provide access to the common riser. The labels are incomplete, and Selka cannot confirm that any valve serves only Flat 3. Selka has no key to either flat. ## 2025-06-18 09:49:00 UTC — event 011 - **Channel:** Email - **From:** Niko Pell (Landlord, Flat 3) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Niko said the tenancy paperwork refers to repairs on notice and separately mentions urgent repairs, but he did not have the full wording available. He was not expressly authorizing entry where Yara had refused consent. ## 2025-06-18 10:02:00 UTC — event 012 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) Bevin reported faster dripping and a new brown patch beside the fitting. No section had fallen. Bevin had not touched the consumer unit and remained outside the bedroom. ## 2025-06-18 10:14:00 UTC — event 013 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Daro Fen (Contractor, Brindle Flow Plumbing) Arlen confirmed Daro's 10:30 attendance for Flat 2 and the common riser, with Selka meeting him. Bevin agreed to provide access to Flat 2. Daro confirmed this would not provide access to Flat 3 or establish which supply, if any, could be isolated. ## 2025-06-18 10:22:00 UTC — event 014 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Runa Elt (Contractor, Vellum Electrical) Arlen requested an urgent qualified electrical attendance for the wet ceiling fitting in Flat 2. Runa confirmed electrical qualifications and offered an attendance window of 12:30–13:15, subject to the tenant providing access. Runa would assess the fitting and circuit; no assessment had yet occurred. ## 2025-06-18 10:31:00 UTC — event 015 - **Channel:** SMS - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) Arlen confirmed the electrician request and asked Bevin to keep the bedroom clear and avoid the fitting and wet ceiling. Bevin replied that they would meet the electrician and continue using the other rooms. ## 2025-06-18 10:48:00 UTC — event 016 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Daro Fen (Contractor, Brindle Flow Plumbing) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Daro and Selka had met as arranged. Daro had access to Flat 2 and the common riser. He saw water at the bedroom ceiling but could not locate the source. The riser labels did not identify a confirmed Flat 3 branch; no valve had been operated. Flat 3 remained inaccessible. ## 2025-06-18 11:02:00 UTC — event 017 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) Bevin reported a shallow-looking bulge in the damp ceiling beside the light and continued dripping. Arlen asked Bevin to stay out of the bedroom and keep others away from the ceiling. Bevin said they were in the living room; no material had fallen and no sparks or smoke were reported. ## 2025-06-18 11:17:00 UTC — event 018 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Runa Elt (Contractor, Vellum Electrical) Runa confirmed the attendance window remained 12:30–13:15 and that the fitting was not considered safe based on the wall switch position. Water had not reached the common corridor. Selka had no authority or key for Flat 3. ## 2025-06-18 12:20:00 UTC — event 022 - **Channel:** Call - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Devra Senn (Duty Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Arlen asked who could authorize emergency access after the occupant refused consent. Devra reviewed the available agency record and found no documented delegated authority for staff to override that refusal; the complete tenancy wording had not been checked. Devra recorded that Niko had not authorized entry. The agency escalation route was to obtain the full agreement and a decision from the agency director; if there were an immediate danger to life or property, contact emergency services and follow the responding authority's direction. No entry authority was confirmed. ## 2025-06-18 12:38:00 UTC — event 023 - **Channel:** SMS - **From:** Bevin Orlo (Tenant, Flat 2) - **To:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) The drip continues and the ceiling bulge appears larger. I am still outside the bedroom and can meet the electrician. I have not seen sparks or smoke, and no material has fallen. ## 2025-06-18 12:55:00 UTC — event 024 - **Channel:** Update - **From:** Arlen Quist (Property Manager, Northbridge Lettings) - **To:** Devra Senn (Duty Manager, Northbridge Lettings) Current record: active dripping and a reportedly enlarging ceiling bulge in Flat 2 beside a wet light fitting; the room is being kept clear, but electrical safety has not been established. Vellum Electrical is due within its stated window. Brindle Flow Plumbing and Selka Venn attended Flat 2 and the common riser, with no source or confirmed isolation point found. Yara continues to withhold consent to Flat 3 entry until she returns; Niko has not authorized entry, and the agency has not verified an applicable emergency-entry authority. The source-flat access and any source isolation remain unresolved. ## Attachments (none)

input.summary: R/008, 8 Tallowmere Row. Water is coming through the bedroom ceiling light fitting in Flat 2 (tenant Bevin Orlo), and the drip has got faster. There is a brown patch and a ceiling bulge that is reported to be getting larger (events 12, 17, 23). Bevin is keeping out of the room. No sparks, smoke or fallen material reported (event 23). Electrical safety has not been established: Vellum Electrical (Runa Elt) is due 12:30–13:15 (events 14, 18). Brindle Flow Plumbing (Daro Fen) and building manager Selka Venn checked Flat 2 and the common riser.
